notes.subject: חלומותיכם ... אשר אתם מחלמים
notes.rationale: KJV 'dreams which ye cause to be dreamed' vs reading the suffixes as 'their dreams which they dream about you' — Hebrew suffixes are ambiguous; suffixes rendered as 'yu ol' following the majority reading.

notes.subject: ol man bilong skelim ol mak
notes.rationale: קוסם is a diviner/soothsayer; 'skelim ol mak' keeps the picture of reading lots or omens.

notes.subject: to the exiles
notes.rationale: Direct negative-imperative address to the exiles concerning their own prophets and dreamers.

translation: Long wanem, olsem Yahwe Tsebaot, Elohim bilong Yisrael, i tok: Ol profet bilong yu ol we i stap namel long yu ol, na ol man bilong skelim ol mak bilong yu ol, ol i no ken givim giaman long yu ol; na yu ol no ken harim long ol drim bilong yu ol, we yu ol yet i wokim ol drim.
